data.narrative:
Vyriy Drone is a Growth-stage company in the Defense & Security sector founded by Oleksiy Babenko, having raised $4M+ in M&A activity as of 2025. The broader sector comprises 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems, though none provide sufficiently tight comps at this stage and scale.

Valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method: Stage-Progression. Using the $4M total raised as a proxy for recent valuation, a typical Growth-stage step-up multiplier of 1.2x yields an implied valuation of $5M. The Peer-Median approach was not applicable; while 22 Defense & Security companies exist in the comp universe, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, and similar-tier peers yielded fewer than three datapoints, making sector-wide medians unreliable without introducing substantial estimation error.

The triangulated valuation range is $4M (low) to $6M (high), with a median of $5M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single quantitative method anchored to recent funding activity. Key uncertainties include the absence of recent arms-length third-party valuations, insufficient stage-matched peer data in the sector, and limited visibility into revenue or unit economics. Validation would benefit from revenue multiples or customer pipeline data once available.
